S187BSS.Settings.BaselineHint: The distance one square represents on an unscaled scene. 5 for feet, 1.5 for meters. Auto-mode profiles compare a scene's grid distance against this to derive the multiplier.
S187BSS.Settings.DebugHint: Log every scaling decision to the console. Useful when a template comes out the wrong size.
S187BSS.NoLibWrapper: Battle Scene Scaling: libWrapper is not active, so range, reach, movement, and vision scaling are disabled. Spell and AoE area scaling still works.
S187BSS.Editor.Title: Scaling Profiles
S187BSS.Editor.MenuHint: Define the scaling profiles that scenes can be assigned.
S187BSS.Editor.Intro: A profile decides how much to scale and what gets scaled. On a scene whose grid is already rescaled, an enabled category keeps its normal square footprint while a disabled one shrinks with the map.
S187BSS.Editor.ModeHint: Auto divides the scene's grid distance by the {baseline} baseline, so the grid and the multiplier can never drift apart. Use Fixed only to scale on a scene whose grid is left unchanged.
S187BSS.Editor.MultiplierHint: Used when the mode is Fixed. Ignored in Auto mode.
S187BSS.Editor.ResetPrompt: Replace every profile with the shipped defaults? Scenes pointing at a profile you have deleted will fall back to no scaling.
S187BSS.Editor.Empty: No profiles defined. Add one, or restore the defaults.
S187BSS.Scene.ProfileHint: Scaling applies only to this scene. Remember to set the grid distance on the Grid tab to match.
S187BSS.Scene.OverrideHint: Overrides the profile's multiplier for this scene only, including Auto mode. Leave blank unless this scene is a genuine exception.
S187BSS.Scene.GridWarning: This scene is not gridless. On a rescaled square grid, movement lands on fractional squares and tokens snap incorrectly. Scaled scenes should be gridless.
S187BSS.Scene.GridlessPending: Grid type set to Gridless. Save the scene to apply it.
S187BSS.Wizard.Title: Create Scaled Scene
S187BSS.Wizard.Intro: Sets the grid to gridless and derives the grid distance from the chosen profile, so the scene's scale and its scaling profile cannot disagree.
S187BSS.Wizard.Name: Scene Name
S187BSS.Wizard.BackgroundHint: Optional. Can be set later in Scene Config.
S187BSS.Wizard.GridSizeHint: Pixels per grid unit on the map image. The ratio of this to the grid distance is what carries the scale.
S187BSS.Wizard.Derived: Grid distance will be set to {distance} {units} per unit (×{multiplier}).
S187BSS.Wizard.ConvertWarning: Converting changes this scene's grid type and distance, which reinterprets every distance already on it.
S187BSS.Wizard.Created: Created scaled scene "{name}" at {distance} per grid unit.
S187BSS.Wizard.ConfirmGridless: Grid type will be switched to Gridless.
S187BSS.Wizard.ConfirmTokens: Tokens will not move — their positions are stored in pixels. But every measured distance on this scene will now mean something different.
